Morrowmark modified selections: model-reviewed noun, verb and adjective meaning renderings derived from exact aligned concepts. Not verbatim bilingual quotations, complete meanings, Mexican-only usage or human certification.
Reproduce: scripts/generate-wordnet-translations.py --check with retained candidates and independent review files in src/data/spanish. Source URLs and checksums are in wordnet-translation-source.json.

Additional lexical selections and supporting Spanish sense material are adapted from Spanish Wiktionary contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0, with model-authored and independently model-reviewed English renderings. These additional adaptations/proofs are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0 while retaining the underlying MCR CC BY 3.0 and Princeton WordNet notices. Legacy WordNet noun mappings retain their existing notices. This does not relicense the project's own MIT compiler/application code.
https://es.wiktionary.org/
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Exact word/source URLs, raw-record hashes, English data.verb/data.adj file checksums, reviewed mappings, prior holds and metadata-only corrections are retained in src/data/spanish wordnet-translation-audit.json and the associated reviewed input files. Definitions are selected lexical meanings, not a new conjugation or reflexive rule, example corpus, native certification or complete Mexican Spanish coverage.
